title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Do uttering the word Talaq thrice at one go can be considered talaq in the light of Quaran and Hadidh? 2867 views Q. I have been seperated from my partner/ex since 2004 now. She walked out with son and made a court case alleging domestic violence etc. After 3 years, Halhamdulillah, the son lives me. She lost her as court decided that she has mental illness. Is Talaq automatic in this case? I have tried to patch up with her but she swore at the case workers.I have also given her talaq over the phone 2 years ago and also some other time, without witnesses but she says do whatever. She also said that my mother will goto hell when she passed away.I need to move on as I am ill and has a son to look after. Please give some advice. Jazakamuullah Khairun. Please guide me with reference to Shariah, I am in love and physical ralation ship with a lady who is married and not yet divorce, but she is pregnant with my child, her husband was in jail for long time and since then she is trying to get Khula from him but everytime he refuse and the case is going on in Family court in Mumbai, because of her husband contact with goondas no Qazi is ready to get involve in this issue, now my worry is that I cant marry her because she is already married and hence my child becomes illegal which is hurting me and I am always praying to Allah that show mw the right path and help me to get married to her so we can live together rest of our life with no sins in our heart, Please tell me how to get married to her before she deliver the baby. Awaiting for your response. 2359 views Q. Assalamu alaikum, Dear Janab Mufti Sahib, I have left my wife on 31st May 2008 to her parent?s house when I came to know from doctor that she was conceived to take rest for two months. After that I called her for which her mother intervened and refused to send her. Because of her mother?s attitude towards me I stopped going to my in laws home. There was no contact between myself and my spouse from July 08 to September 08. During November 2008 my spouse called me over phone and asked for my blood group and I informed her the same. After that there were contacts over phone between me and my spouse till the date of delivery. After delivery I went to see my spouse and new born baby in Hospital. At hospital, her mother again intervened between us and there were heated arguments between me and her mother. After three months of delivery, I sent a letter to my spouse thro? post to come back to my home for which my spouse replied me thro? post ? that she thought of coming back after three months but your letter reached me prior to one day of three months time. (For your information the letter was written in Tamil though I know that my spouse cant write or read tamil) ?. Saying this she made a full stop without informing that whether she wants to come or not. Then I called her relatives (in Bangalore) to come and solve our problem. During the talks, there were heated arguments between my parents and her parents and the talks were failed. Then last Sunday, I called my spouse over phone then suggested her to come to a third parties place where we can sit and solve our differences for which she initially accepted and told me that after her father has gone for Jamaat and he will be returning tonight. Once her comes she will get permission and come on Monday. On Monday morning I called her over phone, she replied after asking her parents bit by bit over phone that I have to come to her parents? house to have any discussion on this, and she refused to come with me. Finally she told me that her relatives who are in Bangalore have to come and we will have an agreement on this after which she will be coming back to my house. In a fit of anger, I sent an SMS with these words ? Aaj ke din main tera aur mera rishta ku qatam karta hoon ye teen lafz se ? Talaq Talaq Talaq ?. Please convey me whether this talaq is valid, in my case I never had any quarrel with my wife nor wife has any dispute over me. The only dispute was with my self and her parents. Please let me know at your earliest. 3337 views Q. TRIPLE TALAQ IN ONE SITTING IN A FIT OF ANGER 35280 views Q. Talaq 1933 views Q. Talaq 1797 views Q. My question belongs to talaq.my wife was not with me since last year. she stayed at her mother's home. after long efferts i came to decission to give talaq. for that i made dd to pay mehar(onelac rupees and six thousand rupees for 2dinar-e-sharai)and iddat maitenance(Rs.12thousands). all amount included in one dd. on 13th june2010 i gave three irrevocable talaq before two witnesses in the presence of qazi also. the dd given to qazi to pass on to my wife. after one week qazi given me sadaqatnama for talaq. after one month i came to a notice that her family members are not informing about this. still she did not taken my dd and that dd is at qazi. she did not recieved any talaq notice and not used mehar amount also. the talaq incident is in this stage only. the situation is going on. now my question is that 'is talaq happend or not?' if she did not taken any notice and dd. qazi told that after 45 days give daily newspaper publication to complete talaq process. is this a correct process or not. and what should i do about dd. can i use that dd even she did not taken or refused it. give me suggestion to walk in correct way. 1742 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 40708 Country: India Title: I got married in 2008 and we have 2 children (26 months and 12 months). I want to get permanent separation from my wife by divorce Question: I got married in 2008 and we have 2 children (26 months and 12 months). I want to get permanent separation from my wife by divorce. Is it necessary to give the justification or reason for divorce as I am not comfortable from the first week of rukhsati? I am trying to minimize the damage as less as possible to both party (me, my wife and childs). Answer ID: 40708 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 722/724/N=1433) Talaq is the most repulsive act in Shariah. One can get 100% wife only in Jannah. Hence we advise you to shun giving talaq to your present wife in any case and in view of the future of children and their proper training solve your differences mutually. May Almighty Allah bring harmony and unity in you relations! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
